# Agent research by year

[简体中文](../../../agent-research/catalog/by-year.md) · English

Browse by first public release year. Papers are listed newest first within each year with a short method description.

## 2026

- 2026-11 · [AlphaProof Code: Verifying Signal's Security at the Machine-Code Level](../../../agent-research/alphaproof-code/README-en.md) (`alphaproof-code`): Symbolic and computational guarantees concern PQXDH and Triple Ratchet, not every possible Signal scenario. Report Sections 2 and 4–5 **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-11 · [ARE-bench: Benchmarking Agents' Research Ability in Real-World Researcher Sessions and Workspaces](../../../agent-research/2611.14364-are-bench/README-en.md) (`are-bench`): Actors see Background, Requirements, Environment and workspace, while evaluators retain the private rubric and provenance. An empty checklist is an error, not a perfect score. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents](../../../agent-research/2611.14320-wikitrace/README-en.md) (`wikitrace`): The agent starts with all insights and can descend when details are missing, insights conflict, or a source failed. An interpretation does not become verified knowledge merely because it has a source link. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [Program-Aided Patchable Skill Evolution](../../../agent-research/2611.14019-pase/README-en.md) (`pase`): A proposed patch is kept only after held-out validation improvement. Program syntax alone establishes neither task correctness nor safety. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows](../../../agent-research/2611.14492-retrace/README-en.md) (`retrace`): ReTrace extracts conditions and argument provenance from reasoning and tool traces, merges cited rules and synthesizes executable workflows. Planner-free does not forbid model-backed tools or mean replaying actions without current observations. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents](../../../agent-research/2611.14326-fgse/README-en.md) (`fgse`): FGSE represents a lesson as a hypothesis with precondition, behavior, expected effect and verifier. It evaluates a temporary state on transfer, targeted falsification and archived regression probes before committing, refining once, or rejecting it. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI](../../../agent-research/2611.09822-verified-quantum-wiki/README-en.md) (`verified-quantum-wiki`): A local Lean success is insufficient for admission. Appendix B requires clean-sandbox replay using Lean Comparator to check all target theorems and transitive definitions. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [ENGRAM: From Agent Experience to Weights through Verified Consolidation](../../../agent-research/2611.09472-engram-consolidation/README-en.md) (`engram-consolidation`): Teacher evidence is separate from student mastery. Only a verified candidate can release eligible records for a skill. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments](../../../agent-research/2611.07372-envopt/README-en.md) (`envopt`): The research agent observes trajectories on disjoint training shards without verifiers. Separate validation then measures the environment candidate; test tasks are not used for selection. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts](../../../agent-research/2611.08452-reprobridge/README-en.md) (`reprobridge`): Matching a target score does not establish procedural fidelity; repetition does not remove systematic execution bias. Sections 2–3 **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration](../../../agent-research/2611.08472-xstack/README-en.md) (`xstack`): The fourteen domains include language models, recommendation, vision and reinforcement learning. Appendix H also shows that a successful headline path need not preserve every feature of a library. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-11 · [From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?](../../../agent-research/2611.05108-continual-autoresearch/README-en.md) (`continual-autoresearch`): Task 1 has no previous experience to transfer and is excluded from transfer gains. Section 3 **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [Meta²: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents](../../../agent-research/2611.05139-meta-square/README-en.md) (`meta-square`): Deployment freezes it and chooses KEEP or EVOLVE at checkpoints; edits affect only the remainder of the current run without resetting the environment. Section 3 and Appendix B **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [RuntimeTickets: Source-Grounded Security Obligations for Agent Skills](../../../agent-research/2611.03772-runtime-tickets/README-en.md) (`runtime-tickets`): Tickets can tighten, never expand, host authority. Section 3, Algorithm 1 **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-11 · [Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents](../../../agent-research/2611.03618-strategist/README-en.md) (`strategist`): Each iteration performs Retrieve, Propose, Evaluate, and Accumulate. Relevance and adjacent-inspiration queries supply material for `new/composed/reuse` candidates. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [AgentHeal: Evaluating Goal-Preserving Resource Recovery of Web Agents under Access Barriers](../../../agent-research/2610.39234-agentheal/README-en.md) (`agentheal`): It distinguishes an exact copy with the same work and version, another version of the same work, and a merely superficial look-alike. The controlled sandbox contains 675 instances: 225 goals each instantiated as barrier-free, recoverable, and unrecoverable. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Training LLM Agents to Automate LLM Post-Training with RSI-Dojo](../../../agent-research/2611.03698-rsi-dojo/README-en.md) (`rsi-dojo`): RSI-Dojo yields 281 training environments, collects frontier-model trajectories with extra harness guidance, then filters process quality and outcomes before fine-tuning agents. Section 3 **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [Remembering Is Not Enough: Refining Memories and Learning When to Use Them in Multi-Agent Systems](../../../agent-research/2610.36652-discernmem/README-en.md) (`discernmem`): Only harmful in-scope effects supported by a concrete trace defect justify content repair; existing avoid conditions take precedence. Evaluate the original task before updating memory, and do not retroactively replace its score with the replay outcome. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement](../../../agent-research/2610.36826-ruharness/README-en.md) (`ruharness`): Small samples can inflate point estimates, so candidate criteria are ranked by a conservative posterior utility. Harness updates still require independent validation; a rubric is not the task objective. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?](../../../agent-research/2610.37276-evalalloc/README-en.md) (`evalalloc`): Observed scores are then combined with predictions for unobserved cells. Final confirmation expands a common random item prefix in rounds and reuses cached observations. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [EMMA: Structured Episodic Memory for Multi-Agent Workflow Synthesis](../../../agent-research/2610.35966-emma/README-en.md) (`emma`): A one-off execution slip gets a temporary plan directive. Reusable behavior belongs in an agent prompt, a missing procedure in a skill, and a decomposition or dispatch error in the controller. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond](../../../agent-research/2610.32802-frontier-opd/README-en.md) (`frontier-opd`): The teacher takes up to $K$ turns and the student continues for $H$. Compare bridge plus continuation against the same-length original window at that position; require valid replay, non-terminal handoff and complete continuation. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency](../../../agent-research/2610.32813-harnessmm/README-en.md) (`harnessmm`): Audit actual execution and a reduction of at least one slow call at the registered parent boundary. Closure alone cannot establish semantic correctness; the benchmark scorer remains necessary. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [ImageRSI: Verification-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Image Generation](../../../agent-research/2610.32120-image-rsi/README-en.md) (`image-rsi`): Compare with/without experience on the same request, input, generation settings and seed using a blinded independent evaluator, then test separately on a holdout. Train the judge offline between collection rounds, not within the same evaluation request or from external test verdicts. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training](../../../agent-research/2610.32026-rsi-opt/README-en.md) (`rsi-opt`): Inner agents cannot see final metrics, but outer scoring uses them; a suite's split named test is not proof of unseen-task transfer. Base LLM weights stay fixed. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration](../../../agent-research/2610.30105-asteroid/README-en.md) (`asteroid`): Fixed-latent BAMDP uses cross-episode history; general POMDP uses expert takeover from reached states. This is not gold in the prompt or ordinary one-step DAgger. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [PLE: Physical-Engineering's Last Exam](../../../agent-research/2610.30537-physical-engineering-exam/README-en.md) (`physical-engineering-exam`): Judges and references stay hidden. The local path freezes artifact bytes and checks provenance before accepting external grades. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Cache Engineering for Agents](../../../agent-research/2610.28577-cache-engineering/README-en.md) (`cache-engineering`): AKV extends a radix structure with position versions, eviction and recovery and explores RSI-generated cache policies. A cache state depends on operation history, not merely the final token prefix. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [Evolving Agent Interfaces](../../../agent-research/2610.28601-agent-s4/README-en.md) (`agent-s4`): Hold the task actor and harness fixed while the meta-agent modifies how it can observe and act, not merely composing tools. The builder sees unlabeled training traces only; validation traces, tasks, diagnostics and scores are withheld and used for parent selection. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Object-Oriented Harness: Evolving Agent Harnesses through Object-Oriented Design](../../../agent-research/2610.28380-oo-harness/README-en.md) (`oo-harness`): Improve on discovery clusters, then freeze classes and experience and route from task and observable base trajectory. Ancestor methods run in one instance, not extra agents. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints](../../../agent-research/2610.26453-tokenworth/README-en.md) (`tokenworth`): Fast updates fit residuals and slow updates adapt the diagonal metric. One score drives retrieval, admission and eviction. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [MemPrice: Online Memory Allocation via Adaptive Pricing for Long-Horizon Agents](../../../agent-research/2610.24955-memprice/README-en.md) (`memprice`): Details deleted from the current window cannot reappear on their own; they can only be re-extracted from the external raw archive at refresh time under a fixed procedure. See Section 3 and Appendix G. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Aptamers as a sandbox for lab-in-the-loop agentic molecular discovery](../../../agent-research/2610.24806-aptamer-lab-loop/README-en.md) (`aptamer-lab-loop`): The paper shows disagreement between some predictive proxies and measured outcomes. This note discusses research orchestration and evidence limits only; it does not provide laboratory procedures. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [Learning to Program Retrievals: Composing Search Primitives via Reinforcement Learning](../../../agent-research/2610.24854-rpl/README-en.md) (`rpl`): When a mutated program passes execution verification, the policy generates a continuation with its evidence, and distillation is interleaved with RL. - 2026-10 · [SCOPE: Selective Certification of Program Edits for Embodied Heuristic Learning](../../../agent-research/2610.23128-scope-replay/README-en.md) (`scope-replay`): When candidate source changes, it selects up to three historical witnesses for local stateful replay; only a divergent instance may be scheduled for a sparse real-environment diagnostic. See Section 3. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds](../../../agent-research/2610.24061-world-of-swecraft/README-en.md) (`world-of-swecraft`): SW-Env uses Harbor sessions and Forgejo to simulate software maintenance, with independent controls for communication permissions, repository ownership, and session budgets. SW-Eval installs frozen versions in hidden downstream packages and checks correctness and instruction counts. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft](../../../agent-research/2610.22319-gemini-minecraft/README-en.md) (`gemini-minecraft`): An Observer summarizes world state, while chat and notes carry progress. The study concerns long-horizon coordination, programmatic tools, and persistent state, not a new training objective. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [AgentPerturb: Evaluating LLM Agent Robustness under Controlled Interaction Perturbations](../../../agent-research/2610.21624-agent-perturb/README-en.md) (`agent-perturb`): Valid JSON is not enough to accept a candidate. A semantic verifier independent of the generator must confirm all four conditions: the edit affects only the specified target, preserves the objective, remains solvable, and is executable. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research](../../../agent-research/2610.21055-athanor/README-en.md) (`athanor`): The team shares experiment records and models and combines SFT, RL, model merging, and self-distillation. Calls to external teachers are prohibited. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning](../../../agent-research/2610.22194-auto-sft/README-en.md) (`auto-sft`): Interventions can rebalance categories, delete or repair data, replace answers, synthesize targeted samples, or change ordering. These six types are a retrospective classification, not a fixed action menu. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [Disagreement-Guided Weak-to-Strong Routing](../../../agent-research/2610.22245-disagreement-routing/README-en.md) (`disagreement-routing`): At test time it uses weak-model representations and two lightweight probes. The strong model is called only when the router escalates. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Diviner: Agentic RCA with Human-Governed Adaptation for Large-Scale Infrastructure](../../../agent-research/2610.21281-diviner/README-en.md) (`diviner`): A timeout does not mean there is no anomaly; a similar historical incident does not establish the current root cause; and a postmortem is not evidence available during the incident. §§4–5 define an Encode/Execute/Evaluate/Adapt loop for domain knowledge, lead–worker investigation, postmortem review, and owner-approved knowledge updates. Runtime adaptation can revise only the current investigation plan, not publish shared workflows or execute mitigation. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [GACC-Bench: Benchmarking Goal-Adaptive Context Compression Ability across Large Language Models](../../../agent-research/2610.21893-gacc-bench/README-en.md) (`gacc-bench`): A fixed reader answers each question from the same compressed memory, then a fixed judge scores against the original source and references. This tests whether compression preserves evidence for the entire goal. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution](../../../agent-research/2610.22466-harness-decomposition/README-en.md) (`harness-decomposition`): If the gain is not significant, attribution stops. Otherwise, construct a compute-matched baseline and an evolved variant with detected shortcuts removed. **Both controls need task-specific human review.** See Section 3. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [Hy-Memory-30B-A3B: Attributed Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory Writing](../../../agent-research/2610.22196-hy-memory/README-en.md) (`hy-memory`): Then freeze the reader and judge and optimize only the writer. Chunk-level probes supplement sparse rewards; cross-chunk factual attribution locates contributions; a growth penalty discourages storing everything. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs](../../../agent-research/2610.21412-jev-agent-harness/README-en.md) (`jev-agent-harness`): It reports success, cost, and critical-path latency. AgentDecision-4B also trains on reached states after errors, rather than imitating only successful trajectories. §§2–4 and Appendices A/D **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents](../../../agent-research/2610.22280-leash/README-en.md) (`leash`): Initial and runtime gates decide handoff. Afterward, it periodically uses representations of unexecuted weak-model Shadow actions to monitor the stronger model and asks it to reconsider when needed. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries](../../../agent-research/2610.22273-librarian-agents/README-en.md) (`librarian-agents`): CreateFile, MergeFiles, Delete, and Stop form a finite-horizon MDP. Delete can never remove raw documents. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [MemoProAgent: Toward Memory-Driven Proactive Assistance](../../../agent-research/2610.22671-proper-agent/README-en.md) (`proper-agent`): Training applies policy gradients to generated tokens only, not tool-injected evidence. See Section 5 and Appendix I. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [MemScope: Evolving Agent Memory Architectures through Localized Code Repair](../../../agent-research/2610.21170-memscope/README-en.md) (`memscope`): It locates a cause and makes a bounded in-place change that preserves provider identity and compatibility with existing memory. If evidence is insufficient, it can explicitly select no patch instead of forcing an edit every round. §3 and Appendices A–B **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [PROBE: Learning to Audit Policy Compliance in Tool-Using LLM Agents](../../../agent-research/2610.22124-probe/README-en.md) (`probe`): Rewards combine violations, credible customer behavior, tool-workflow progress, and policy diversity. The paper compares GRPO, DPO, and GFlowNet. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Repairing LLM-Generated Specifications with Deterministic Diagnosis](../../../agent-research/2610.22568-drago/README-en.md) (`drago`): Reference formalizations and final labels are used only for final scoring. - 2026-10 · [RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent](../../../agent-research/2610.21791-rsiflow/README-en.md) (`rsiflow`): Meta-model parameters remain fixed. The local component follows the released skill-memory variant and does not turn it into a system for arbitrary code self-modification. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [SciPIvot: Benchmarking Principal-Investigator Judgment at Pivotal Moments of Scientific AutoResearch Agents](../../../agent-research/2610.21082-scipivot/README-en.md) (`scipivot`): Reference construction can use subsequent records. The evaluated model may see at most the project state before correction, never future traces, correct labels, or the origins of the options. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [Shortcut Sensitivity in Agent-Safety Evaluations](../../../agent-research/2610.22243-shortcut-sensitivity/README-en.md) (`shortcut-sensitivity`): The paper uses a three-level inference ladder: first, whether cues predict labels; second, whether cues correlate with guard decisions; and third, whether a paired intervention that changes only the cue changes those decisions. Each level only motivates the next test; it does not establish that the model used a shortcut. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [SSR: Structural Signal Retriever for Scalable Agent Discovery in LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Agent Systems](../../../agent-research/2610.21113-structural-signal-retriever/README-en.md) (`structural-signal-retriever`): It extracts interpretable lexical signals from explicit capability fields, then uses an inverted index to narrow the candidate pool before selection. “Structural” refers to the fields name, description, skills, tags, examples, and tools, not to syntactic graphs or latent vectors. Its core lexical mechanism is a specific integration of existing IDF retrieval, not a new semantic model. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive Self-Rewrite and Policy-Refine](../../../agent-research/2610.22192-terminal-rsi/README-en.md) (`terminal-rsi`): Terminal-RSI alternates RSR trajectory rewriting with RPR that retains critic weights, calibrating the critic at the start of each stage. It proposes TB-GAE, which discounts on an interaction-turn clock rather than by observation text length, and uses family-calibrated FDR before switching to strictly completion-first SPR. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [ToolBottleneckBench: Measuring Tool-Agent Performance under Controlled Pressures and Fixed Harness Budgets](../../../agent-research/2610.21098-tool-bottleneck-bench/README-en.md) (`tool-bottleneck-bench`): The original protocol has 36 task families and 12 enterprise intents. Routed menus use ground truth to narrow candidates, so they are not evidence of an oracle-free capability. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [TRACER: Trajectory-Aware Tool Retrieval for LLM Agents](../../../agent-research/2610.21267-tracer/README-en.md) (`tracer`): Two five-dimensional linear heads learn a state-dependent weight between the empirical and contextual priors and a temperature. For unseen prefixes or low confidence, retrieval falls back to vector search across the full registry. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [AlphaDiana: A Measurement System for Agents in Verifiable Reasoning Tasks](../../../agent-research/2610.20675-alpha-diana/README-en.md) (`alpha-diana`): Reporting only successful tasks or mean tokens can hide missing grades, execution failures, and retry costs. AlphaDiana compares complete model–harness systems under common tasks, sampling, and resource policies while retaining each harness's native execution. §2 and Appendices A–B **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [ARIA: Runtime Inspection and Amendment for Multi-Agent Systems](../../../agent-research/2610.20780-aria/README-en.md) (`aria`): Section 2 and Appendix B describe structure SFT, repair DPO, diagnosis transfer, repair GRPO and gate GRPO. The local component extracts a testable patch contract; it does not substitute heuristics for those learning stages. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Evolving Together, Failing Apart: The Skill-Policy Co-evolution Trap in Self-Improving Agents](../../../agent-research/2610.20845-coda/README-en.md) (`coda`): Sections 3–4 and Appendix E retrieve once from the original bank and freeze selected IDs and retrieval-side fields. Only content is replaced; retrieving again would introduce a confound. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [Maximising Transparency in Context Compaction Improves Retention of Facts and Commitments for Lightweight Coding Agents](../../../agent-research/2610.20116-transparent-compact/README-en.md) (`transparent-compact`): Compaction does not call a model, but the paper's `context_lookup` uses a model subagent to search history. These are not a single model-free full recovery capability. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [Recursive Formation and First-Class Reuse of Compositional Capabilities](../../../agent-research/2610.19414-formcraft/README-en.md) (`formcraft`): A composite becomes an ordinary candidate for later search, which need not revisit its formation history. The composite's internal computations still execute at runtime. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-10 · [The World Won't Wait: Evaluating and Teaching Agents Under a Live Clock](../../../agent-research/2610.20665-torsi/README-en.md) (`torsi`): After it is frozen, only independent validation decides whether the new guidance replaces the old. Test data never participates in revision or selection. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.** [Method reference 1](<https://arxiv.org/html/2610.20665v1>)
- 2026-10 · [What Coding Agents Leave Unsaid: Measuring Task-State Gaps Between Execution and Reports](../../../agent-research/2610.20003-ctxgap/README-en.md) (`ctxgap`): The main sample has 37 tasks, 148 checkpoints, and 4,855 probes, of which 4,799 are valid. Released text probes and execution materials are only a subset. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [CLASHarness: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Conflict in Computer Use via a Controllable and Verifiable Generation Pipeline](../../../agent-research/2610.19128-clasharness/README-en.md) (`clasharness`): The eight-stage pipeline builds a shared world, role rules and multi-turn scenarios. Each round fixes ground truth $v^\star$, constructs and executes a reference plan in isolation, compiles deterministic and semantic checks from trajectory effects, then checks consistency, visuals and rendering. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
- 2026-10 · [RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution](../../../reproductions/2610.15772-rsipo/README-en.md) (`rsipo`): Static or offline-trained skills may not keep up with an improving policy, and a skill-augmented teacher can underperform its student. RSIPO produces skills from current-policy trajectories, measures their benefit with independent controls and matched initial-state replay, and jointly optimizes skill generation, RLVR, and self-distillation weighted by empirical-Bayes reliability. **Not reproduced for now due to cost; validation pending, no executable entry.**
- 2026-10 · [Harmony Harness: Multi-Objective Self-Evolution of Agent Harnesses](../../../agent-research/2610.15150-harmony-harness/README-en.md) (`harmony-harness`): Harmony Harness keeps functionality and safety as separate objectives: each preference vector has a harness, and a candidate replaces only worse neighbors. - 2026-10 · [Beyond the Final Embedding: Retrieving Memories from Token-Level Evidence](../../../reproductions/2610.13277-beyond-final-embedding/README-en.md) (`beyond-final-embedding`): Each query token uses its worst returned similarity, clipped at zero, as a common floor for absent token–memory matches. The sparse local and full pooled branches are standardized per query before fusion.

- 2026-02 · [AIRS-Bench: a Suite of Tasks for Frontier AI Research Science Agents](../../../agent-research/2602.06855-airs-bench/README-en.md) (`airs-bench`): The protocol distinguishes the agent, search scaffold, and execution harness and compares sequential MLGym with tree-search AIRA-dojo. See Sections 3–5. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-02 · [MARS: Modular Agent with Reflective Search for Automated AI Research](../../../agent-research/2602.02660-mars-research/README-en.md) (`mars-research`): Budget-aware MCTS chooses whether to create, improve, or debug a solution. Comparing old and new execution results and code diffs yields solution and debugging lessons reusable by other branches. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-02 · [MemSkill](../../../agent-research/2602.02474-memskill/README-en.md) (`memskill`): The controller selects memories from past episodes. The designer compiles recurring successful patterns into skills and updates their versions using new feedback.
- 2026-01 · [PEARL](../../../agent-research/2601.20439-pearl/README-en.md) (`pearl`): The offline stage learns tool usage and failure conditions by trial and error. The online stage separates Planner and Executor and applies GRPO with a dense reward for plan correctness, tool chains, and final outcomes rather than relying only on sparse success.
- 2026-01 · [Dynamic Cogeneration of Bug Reproduction Test in Agentic Program Repair](../../../agent-research/2601.19066-dynamic-brt/README-en.md) (`dynamic-brt`): A generated fix agreeing with its own test is not proof of correctness. Section 3. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-01 · [LifeAgentBench: Benchmarking LLMs for Long-Horizon, Cross-Dimensional Lifestyle Health Reasoning](../../../agent-research/2601.13880-lifeagentbench/README-en.md) (`lifeagentbench`): LifeAgent is a separate tool-reasoning baseline: decompose questions, maintain an evidence cache and intermediate statistics, revise plans based on new evidence, and synthesize answers. A benchmark scorer is not this agent. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2026-01 · [CoReflect: A Reflective Co-Evolution Framework for Improving Conversational Evaluation](../../../agent-research/2601.12208-coreflect/README-en.md) (`coreflect`): Planner, simulator, evaluator, and analyzer are core semantic models. A JSON state machine, arithmetic means, or manual rubric edits do not reproduce them, so no cheap heuristic adapter is offered. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**

## 2025

- 2025-12 · [SAGE](../../../agent-research/2512.17102-sage/README-en.md) (`sage`): Abstract skills from successful trajectories, revise or retire them after failures, and use task rewards to learn retrieval and reuse.
- 2025-12 · [Learning Steerable Clarification Policies with Collaborative Self-play](../../../agent-research/2512.04068-clarification-sgp/README-en.md) (`clarification-sgp`): Training does not simply take one lucky high-reward rollout. It filters low-F1 or noncompliant user trajectories, averages each action sequence within each interpretation and then across interpretations, selects the best sequence, and retains its best rollout per interpretation. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2025-11 · [Budget-Aware Tool Use Enables Effective Agent Scaling](../../../agent-research/2511.17006-bats/README-en.md) (`bats`): BATS combines that signal with planning, constraint-by-constraint self-verification, and repeated attempts. It does not simply spawn a fixed number of parallel agents: remaining resources inform whether to continue a direction or pivot. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2025-11 · [Agent0](../../../agent-research/2511.16043-agent0/README-en.md) (`agent0`): A proposer generates verifiable tool tasks. Multiple execution agents produce candidates and vote; increase curriculum difficulty along the current capability boundary.
- 2025-11 · [Agent-R1](../../../agent-research/2511.14460-agent-r1/README-en.md) (`agent-r1`): Treat each agent/environment interaction as a transition. Pluggable context management, environment interfaces, and optimizers support token- or step-level credit.
- 2025-10 · [LEGOMem](../../../agent-research/2510.04851-legomem/README-en.md) (`legomem`): LEGOMem breaks experience into composable procedural units. Orchestrator memory stores decomposition and delegation, agent memory stores action templates, and the units are recombined at runtime for each new task.
- 2025-10 · [Watch and Learn: Learning to Use Computers from Online Videos](../../../agent-research/2510.04673-watch-and-learn/README-en.md) (`watch-and-learn`): Task retrieval turns these annotations into trajectories for in-context demonstrations and supervised computer-use agent (CUA) training. A generic LLM is not asked to guess actions, and rules do not reconstruct trajectories. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2025-09 · [DS-STAR: Data Science Agent via Iterative Planning and Verification](../../../agent-research/2509.21825-ds-star/README-en.md) (`ds-star`): The verifier sees the query, cumulative plan, code and execution output. If insufficient, the router distinguishes a correct but incomplete plan from a plan containing an erroneous step: append in the former case; remove the erroneous step and its suffix, then generate a new step, in the latter. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2025-09 · [An AI system to help scientists write expert-level empirical software (ERA)](../../../agent-research/2509.06503-era-flat-puct/README-en.md) (`era-flat-puct`): Unlike recursive root-to-child MCTS, **every evaluated node competes directly**. A deep node can be expanded immediately. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2025-08 · [MUA-RL](../../../agent-research/2508.18669-mua-rl/README-en.md) (`mua-rl`): The agent clarifies intent in conversation and calls real MCP or database tools. User messages and tool results do not contribute to policy loss; exploration uses only the final task-completion reward.
- 2025-08 · [ToolGrad: Efficient Tool-Use Dataset Generation with Textual Gradients](../../../agent-research/2508.04086-toolgrad/README-en.md) (`toolgrad`): Work backward from a target answer to propose tool traces, then use textual gradients to locate and revise failed calls, reducing manual annotation.
- 2025-08 · [Agent Lightning](../../../agent-research/2508.03680-agent-lightning/README-en.md) (`agent-lightning`): Decouple execution from training. Log interactions as unified MDP transitions and assign credit to pieces of a long trace, rather than concatenating everything into one framework-specific sequence.
- 2025-07 · [MemTool](../../../agent-research/2507.21428-memtool/README-en.md) (`memtool`): MemTool compares autonomous, workflow, and hybrid management. The hybrid policy protects tools required by the current workflow and dynamically evicts other tools based on recency and historical success.
- 2025-06 · [AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery](../../../agent-research/2506.13131-alphaevolve/README-en.md) (`alphaevolve`): Controller, proposal workers, and evaluation pools run asynchronously for aggregate throughput. Sections 2.1–2.6 **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2025-05 · [MLE-STAR: Machine Learning Engineering Agent via Search and Targeted Refinement](../../../agent-research/2506.15692-mle-star/README-en.md) (`mle-star`): Ensemble search and leakage/data-use checks are separate agents. Sections 3.1–3.4 **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**
- 2025-05 · [WebAgent-R1](../../../agent-research/2505.16421-webagent-r1/README-en.md) (`webagent-r1`): WebAgent-R1 dynamically retains recent and task-relevant context, collects full multi-turn trajectories in parallel, and uses M-GRPO to update relative to group rewards for final success. The paper also emphasizes behavior-cloning warm-up and long chain-of-thought initialization.
- 2025-05 · [GiGPO](../../../agent-research/2505.10978-gigpo/README-en.md) (`gigpo`): Sparse final rewards and whole-trajectory relative advantages cannot distinguish useful environment steps. Compute a macro advantage across full trajectories and a micro advantage across steps sharing an anchor state.
- 2025-04 · [RAGEN](../../../agent-research/2504.20073-ragen/README-en.md) (`ragen`): The paper observes an Echo Trap in which reward variance suddenly collapses with a gradient spike. StarPO-S uses trajectory filtering, a critic baseline, gradient stabilization, and decoupled clipping to suppress this self-reinforcing repetition.
- 2025-04 · [ToolRL](../../../agent-research/2504.13958-toolrl/README-en.md) (`toolrl`): Jointly optimize tool selection, arguments, and execution results. Dynamic reward scaling mixes tools of different difficulty within an RL batch.
- 2025-04 · [ReTool](../../../agent-research/2504.11536-retool/README-en.md) (`retool`): Alternate natural-language reasoning and executable tool actions. Use execution feedback to learn tool invocation, correction and stopping.
- 2025-04 · [DeepResearcher](../../../agent-research/2504.03160-deepresearcher/README-en.md) (`deepresearcher`): Treat searching, browsing, collecting evidence, and citing answers as one trajectory. Train with joint answer and citation reward.
- 2025-03 · [Search-R1](../../../agent-research/2503.09516-search-r1/README-en.md) (`search-r1`): The model emits search actions during reasoning and resumes when documents return. PPO/GRPO loss applies only to model-generated tokens; retrieved tokens are masked and a simple outcome reward scores the final answer.
- 2025-03 · [SOPBench: Evaluating Language Agents at Following Standard Operating Procedures and Constraints](../../../agent-research/2503.08669-sopbench-protocol/README-en.md) (`sopbench-protocol`): It checks the final database, whether service was permitted, and whether required verification occurred in order; guessing the final answer cannot bypass the procedure. Constraints map to helpers and can be nested: Single, And (unordered children), Or (a verified true branch) and Chain (strict order). **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2025-02 · [LOOP](../../../agent-research/2502.01600-loop/README-en.md) (`loop`): LOOP combines PPO's trust region with a leave-one-out baseline so it can update repeatedly on a batch without a critic. Token-level importance-ratio clipping limits drifting tokens without discarding whole long trajectories.

## 2024

- 2024-07 · [OpenHands](../../../agent-research/2407.16741-openhands/README-en.md) (`openhands`): OpenHands is an open software agent platform. It unifies terminal, editor and browser actions in an observable event stream and isolates execution in a sandbox for bug fixes, implementation and repository maintenance.
- 2024-05 · [SWE-agent](../../../agent-research/2405.15793-swe-agent/README-en.md) (`swe-agent`): A general-purpose shell exposes an overly broad action space and verbose output to an LLM. SWE-agent's specialized ACI constrains repository search, file viewing, precise editing, and testing so the model can locate the cause of an issue and validate a patch.

## 2023

- 2023-11 · [GAIA](../../../agent-research/2311.12983-gaia/README-en.md) (`gaia`): Evaluate reasoning, multimodality, browsing, and tool use on 466 real problems with exact short answers and three difficulty levels.
- 2023-10 · [MemGPT](../../../agent-research/2310.08560-memgpt/README-en.md) (`memgpt`): MemGPT borrows operating-system virtual memory: resident core information, active working context, and an external archive. Function calls move data, and interrupts or heartbeats control continued reasoning and interaction with the user.
- 2023-10 · [LATS](../../../agent-research/2310.04406-lats/README-en.md) (`lats`): Use an LM as agent, value function and optimizer within MCTS. External execution supplies rewards; reflections on failed traces guide later exploration and backtracking.
- 2023-08 · [AutoGen](../../../agent-research/2308.08155-autogen/README-en.md) (`autogen`): Complex applications need models, tools, and humans to collaborate; hand-written control flow is hard to reuse. ConversableAgent and conversation programming let roles declare capabilities, reply policies, and termination conditions, then combine them through group chats or nested conversations.
- 2023-08 · [MetaGPT](../../../agent-research/2308.00352-metagpt/README-en.md) (`metagpt`): MetaGPT encodes human software-team SOPs as role-based message flows. Each role produces structured intermediates for downstream roles to consume and verify.
- 2023-05 · [ReWOO](../../../agent-research/2305.18323-rewoo/README-en.md) (`rewoo`): Instead of reprompting a ReAct planner after every tool response, write a full plan with variable references. A Worker populates tool evidence and a Solver integrates it once at the end.
- 2023-05 · [ToolBench](../../../agent-research/2305.16504-toolbench/README-en.md) (`toolbench`): After analyzing tool failures in open-source LLMs, the method combines programmatic usage examples, a system prompt, retrieval of in-context demonstrations, and output-format constraints.
- 2023-05 · [Voyager](../../../agent-research/2305.16291-voyager/README-en.md) (`voyager`): Voyager uses GPT-4 to generate curricula and code as its action space. Successful programs are indexed by description in a skill library, then retrieved and composed for new tasks.
- 2023-05 · [CRITIC](../../../agent-research/2305.11738-critic/README-en.md) (`critic`): Pure reflection can repeat a model's original mistake. CRITIC adds observable evidence from external tools, such as search and code execution, to each critique-and-revision iteration.
- 2023-05 · [Tree of Thoughts](../../../agent-research/2305.10601-tree-of-thoughts/README-en.md) (`tree-of-thoughts`): Treat intermediate thoughts as independently evaluable units. Expand multiple candidates, score the frontier with an LM value function, and search BFS or DFS with lookahead and backtracking instead of committing to one chain.
- 2023-04 · [Generative Agents](../../../agent-research/2304.03442-generative-agents/README-en.md) (`generative-agents`): Store observations in a memory stream and retrieve by recency, importance and relevance. Once cumulative importance crosses a threshold, generate higher-level reflections, then use memory and current state for schedules and action plans.
- 2023-03 · [CAMEL](../../../agent-research/2303.17760-camel/README-en.md) (`camel`): Inception prompts define user and assistant roles, goals, and constraints. Alternating messages solve tasks and produce multi-agent trajectories for study.
- 2023-03 · [HuggingGPT](../../../agent-research/2303.17580-hugginggpt/README-en.md) (`hugginggpt`): ChatGPT decomposes requests into a dependency graph, selects experts by their Hugging Face descriptions, executes in topological order, and synthesizes outputs.
- 2023-03 · [Self-Refine](../../../agent-research/2303.17651-self-refine/README-en.md) (`self-refine`): One LLM writes a draft, produces actionable task-specific feedback, and revises until feedback says the constraints are met. No weight updates, extra training data, human feedback or external reward model.
- 2023-03 · [Reflexion](../../../agent-research/2303.11366-reflexion/README-en.md) (`reflexion`): Reflexion expands sparse scalar or binary feedback into actionable natural-language lessons stored in episodic memory. The Actor reads reflections on the next trial, and the Evaluator continues to judge success or failure.
- 2023-03 · [ART](../../../agent-research/2303.09014-art/README-en.md) (`art`): A frozen LLM produces a program; generation pauses at tool markers and resumes after injecting results. Humans can expand the library with a few corrections.
- 2023-02 · [Toolformer](../../../agent-research/2302.04761-toolformer/README-en.md) (`toolformer`): Sample candidate API calls from few-shot examples. Compare downstream token losses for real tool results, masked results and no call, and keep only helpful calls for continued training.

## 2022

- 2022-11 · [PAL](../../../agent-research/2211.10435-pal/README-en.md) (`pal`): LLMs can decompose a task but make arithmetic or symbolic execution mistakes. PAL synthesizes a program with variables and control flow, then uses a deterministic runtime such as Python for exact calculation.
- 2022-10 · [ReAct](../../../agent-research/2210.03629-react/README-en.md) (`react`): ReAct alternates natural-language reasoning with environment actions and adds each observation to the next context. Reasoning can correct errors and actions can obtain external facts.
- 2022-05 · [MRKL](../../../agent-research/2205.00445-mrkl/README-en.md) (`mrkl`): Discrete modules provide deterministic computation; the LM handles language understanding and the interface. The contribution is routing and modular boundaries, not a new LM loss.
- 2022-04 · [SayCan](../../../agent-research/2204.01691-saycan/README-en.md) (`saycan`): Score each pretrained skill by language relevance and value-function affordance. Execute the best product and append the action to context before replanning.

## 2021

- 2021-12 · [WebGPT](../../../agent-research/2112.09332-webgpt/README-en.md) (`webgpt`): WebGPT searches, clicks, and scrolls in a text browser and collects citations for answers. It first trains with behavior cloning, then uses a human-preference reward model to reject-sample among browser and answer trajectories.

## Not recorded

- Not recorded · [AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics](../../../agent-research/autoformbench/README-en.md) (`autoformbench`): There are two distinct settings. The paper leaderboard provides agents with the informal source text (**source-present**). **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**
